text:
## Policy Statement  
**FirstUK Bank protects customer data and systems through defense-in-depth security controls, incident response, and continuous threat monitoring.**  
---
name: Chunk 5/32

raw_entities.name: Information Security Policy
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank's overarching policy mandating the protection of customer data and systems through defense-in-depth security controls, incident response procedures, and continuous threat monitoring. The policy establishes the bank's commitment to multi-layered security safeguards and proactive threat detection.
context: FirstUK Bank protects customer data and systems through defense-in-depth security controls, incident response, and continuous threat monitoring.

raw_entities.name: Data Breach
raw_entities.description: The risk of unauthorized access to or compromise of customer data held by FirstUK Bank. This risk category encompasses threats to the confidentiality and integrity of sensitive customer information.
context: FirstUK Bank protects customer data and systems through defense-in-depth security controls

raw_entities.name: Information Security Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk of compromise, disruption, or unauthorized access to FirstUK Bank's systems and infrastructure. This encompasses threats to system availability, integrity, and confidentiality.
context: FirstUK Bank protects customer data and systems through defense-in-depth security controls, incident response, and continuous threat monitoring.

raw_entities.name: Defense-in-Depth Security Controls
raw_entities.description: A multi-layered security control framework implemented by FirstUK Bank to protect customer data and systems. The defense-in-depth approach employs multiple independent security mechanisms to ensure that compromise of one layer does not result in total system failure.
context: FirstUK Bank protects customer data and systems through defense-in-depth security controls

raw_entities.name: Incident Response
raw_entities.description: The operational procedures and protocols established by FirstUK Bank to detect, respond to, and manage security incidents affecting customer data and systems. This control measure is a core component of the bank's information security framework.
context: FirstUK Bank protects customer data and systems through defense-in-depth security controls, incident response, and continuous threat monitoring.

raw_entities.name: Continuous Threat Monitoring
raw_entities.description: A continuous monitoring mechanism implemented by FirstUK Bank to detect and identify security threats to customer data and systems. This proactive control measure enables early detection and response to emerging threats.
context: FirstUK Bank protects customer data and systems through defense-in-depth security controls, incident response, and continuous threat monitoring.
